excerpt.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported.** The reported conclusion is that these data and this group analysis do not support a positive vmPFC gain effect after whole-brain correction. That bounded conclusion is supported by the method and supplied results. The reported outcome is separate from the checklist verdicts: no vmPFC voxel survived positive one-sided max-T FWE correction across the common-coverage mask (198,029 voxels; 10,000 participant-level whole-image sign flips; α=.05). The operational vmPFC summary was −0.00051 estimate units, with an uncorrected 95% t interval [−0.0222, 0.0212] and one-sided p=.519. The interval includes positive and negative effects, so the result does not establish a zero effect or exclude a smaller increase. Twenty-four corrected positive voxels occurred in three small posterior occipital clusters outside the operational vmPFC mask.
